text-scene.text:
SQL Island: The Quest for the Hidden Data
Far beyond the usual networks and databases, in the middle of the Digital Ocean, lies a mysterious land known as SQL Island. This island was created long ago by the legendary Data Architects, who hid powerful knowledge inside ancient data tables scattered across the island.

You are a young Data Explorer, sent by the Order of Query Masters to investigate the island. Y our mission is to uncover lost records, analyze hidden datasets, and restore the ancient database system that once powered the island civilization.

For your first journey, you must master three ancient spells:
- MIN() – Reveal the smallest value in a dataset - MAX() – Reveal the greatest value in a dataset - ANY – Compare a value against a group of values
Your adventure begins now!
